q: What should I bring to my first visit?
a: Please bring a valid ID and a list of any medicines you take. Arrive about 10 minutes early.
We recommend booking so we can prepare for your visit. Tap Book appointment here in the chat to choose a time.

q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
a: Yes. Tell us here in the chat or call the clinic as early as you can, so the slot can go to another patient.

q: What should I do after a treatment?
a: Follow the aftercare instructions from your provider. If you notice redness, swelling, pain or anything unusual, call the clinic right away.

q: How much is laser hair removal?
a: Laser hair removal (underarm) is ₱1,500 per session, or ₱6,000 for a 5-session package.
